en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It would not get impoverished, a house wherein is vinegar, and Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> had said that’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘

A house in which there is vinegar does not become needy, and the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has already said it.’”
